name: openhyperknow
description: Open-source AI learning platform — Hyperknow clone on pi AgentSession SDK

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix backend run dev & sleep 4 && cd backend && node test/e2e-course-gen.mjs && node test/e2e-whiteboard.mjs
